data.description:
## Context / Problem

`build_server` in `src/rebar/mcp_server.py` (around line 432) constructs `mcp.server.auth.settings.AuthSettings(issuer_url=..., resource_server_url=..., required_scopes=...)` without setting `validate_token_resource`. With `mcp` 1.30.0 installed, every authenticated HTTP boot emits a `DeprecationWarning`: the field is unset, so bearer tokens are not checked against `resource_server_url`, and the library says the default becomes True in `mcp` 3.0 when `resource_server_url` is set.

Observed 2026-11-03 PST in `pytest tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_auth_jwks.py` (`test_jwt_transport_valid_200_garbage_401`), while working bug `precosmic-convictive-aardwolf`. No code in `src/`, `tests/`, or `pyproject.toml` mentions `validate_token_resource`.

Impact today is limited: `pyproject.toml` caps `mcp` below 2, so the default flip cannot arrive without a deliberate major bump. But the resource-binding behaviour is currently decided by a library default rather than by rebar, and the warning shows up in every authenticated test run.

## Approach

Decide whether the composite verifier already enforces the audience/resource (the JWKS verifier passes `audience=resource` to `jwt.decode`; the PAT/other strategies need checking). Set `validate_token_resource` explicitly in `build_server` to match that decision, and add a test asserting the constructed `AuthSettings` value so the warning stays gone.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `build_server` sets `validate_token_resource` explicitly, with a comment stating which component enforces token audience/resource.
- [ ] `pytest tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_auth_jwks.py -W error::DeprecationWarning -k transport` passes.
data.title: Set AuthSettings.validate_token_resource explicitly in build_server
